# Deviations record, worker ContinueRQLS10b (v1)

Recorded 2026-10-19T02:34:18-0700 (from /bin/date). Append-only by new versions; this file is not edited after freezing.

- D-1 (2026-10-19T02:14, probe z5_flat_rank2_projectors_v1): two bookkeeping thresholds were wrong (MUB-pair block-norm
  test 1e-6 below the ~6e-6 stopping displacement at degenerate zeros; kernel-count cut-off 1e-18 inside round-off). Raw
  data intact; correct reading in evidence/z5_flat_rank2_projectors_v1.receipt.md; classification redone in v3-v5.
  No claim rests on the v1 labels.
- D-2 (2026-10-19T02:22:32, probe w8_flat_planes_couples_v2): crash (ZeroDivisionError in frame()) after its search
  stage; EXIT 1, no output file; settled. Superseded by v3 (single fix).
- D-3 (written 02:26-02:29): four files carry a "Recorded" time that was ESTIMATED from an earlier /bin/date reading
  instead of read from /bin/date: evidence/z5_flat_rank2_projectors_v1.receipt.md ("02:26:00", earlier reading 02:25:07
  quoted), review/rqls10-r9-GO-request-v1.md ("02:28:30"), evidence/z9p1_resolution_classes_v1.receipt.md ("02:29:00"),
  evidence/w8_flat_planes_couples_v3.receipt.md ("02:29:30"). /bin/date at the end of that writing was
  2026-10-19T02:28:44-0700, so the last two stamps are later than the actual write. The /bin/date readings quoted inside
  those files (02:25:07, 02:27:18) are the true anchors. Files are frozen and not edited; from 02:29 on every stamp is a
  literal /bin/date reading.
- Note (not a deviation): the float probes are stdlib-only, <= 300 s, single process, launched with PID = PGID recorded
  by a wrapper before work; they are labelled evidence-only and no impossibility claim uses them as a premise.

# Deviations record, worker ContinueRQLS10b (v2; supersedes v1 272d54e40757f8cd0ab913a02682fa164f3eddf1d7d3700aa8adaff2ada09fe9)

Recorded 2026-10-19T02:41:28-0700 (from /bin/date). D-1 to D-3 unchanged from v1 (summarised); D-4 new.

- D-1 (02:14, z5_flat_rank2_projectors_v1): wrong bookkeeping thresholds (MUB-pair label, kernel count); data re-read in
  its receipt; classification redone in v3-v5. No claim rests on the v1 labels.
- D-2 (02:22, w8_flat_planes_couples_v2): crash in frame(), EXIT 1, no output; superseded by v3.
- D-3 (02:26-02:29): four "Recorded" stamps estimated instead of read from /bin/date (z5_flat_rank2_projectors_v1.receipt.md,
  rqls10-r9-GO-request-v1.md, z9p1_resolution_classes_v1.receipt.md, w8_flat_planes_couples_v3.receipt.md); actual
  /bin/date after that writing 2026-10-19T02:28:44-0700; true anchors quoted inside.
- D-4 (found 02:36, w8_flat_planes_couples_v3/v4): the strict couple-compatibility rule (relative lambda_1 < 1e-18)
  undercounted compatible pairs: v5 shows a clean gap (lambda_1 <= 10^-16.2 or >= 10^-0.96) and with a rule inside the
  gap the counts are MUB-MUB 90/90/90 and exotic-exotic 20/20/20 (not 83/67/75 and 13/18/15 or 16/17/14 as in the v3
  receipt 6f43db55...e5a and the v4 run). The v3/v4 K4 statements stay true for the assignments they list; the
  gap-justified v5 rule confirms that no K4 assignment contains an exotic plane; the extra all-MUB assignments are
  covered by the written Theorem A. Correct counts: evidence/w8_flat_planes_couples_v4_v5.receipt.md.
- Tool-side note (not a lane-contract item): one bash call used /usr/bin/tail on df output (02:09); no effect on files.

# Deviations record, worker ContinueRQLS10b (v3; supersedes v2 b2c9e42c1b84e57a12c25aa4049843d938d5d31337ac2562444ddd23a7272ce2)

Recorded 2026-10-19T04:12:36-0700 (from /bin/date). D-1 to D-4 unchanged (see v2).

- D-5 (04:12, review/rqls10-wh10-GO-request-v1.md 0d6f91f1...93d7): the abbreviated hash of code/rqls_w8_lm_v2.py is
  written "d336e2e3...a9fd"; the correct sha256 is d336e2e3d3fdbc0afe9cc1e55232524466152e4369519e47a387cc9caf061ca2. The
  file is only cited there as the origin of the copied LM damping schedule; no pin depends on it. The frozen request is
  not edited; this record corrects it.
- D-6 (wording, found by the parent): the hand-off sentence that exact trades "stop at 13-14 rays" overstated the
  result. 13 is proved only for R-trades from the Parker points; 14 is the maximum FOUND in bounded general searches,
  not a ceiling. Recorded in checkpoints/015-checkpoint-v1.md (98d5bcc9...a1d2); frozen notes are accurate on this point
  (exact-trades-lemma-v1.md says "saturated at 14 in the bounded search").

Recorded 2026-10-19T05:07:01-0700 (from /bin/date). D-1 to D-6 unchanged (see v2, v3).

  it was sent afterwards (04:5x) and the parent registered both as SETTLED with a late-registration note. From
  fixedb_jacobian_v1 on, launch records are sent before each run.
- D-9 (source download location): the eprint of arXiv:2507.20154 was fetched with curl into lane tmp/ (the probes'
  TMPDIR) at ~04:44 and moved with mv -n to sources/han-zang-zhang-tian-2507.20154.eprint (0444,
  3f85d5262a1ce7a12de39a4fa432de6b740209a2b3bd6ca62af7c22b0633d891); no probe was running; tmp/ was empty afterwards.
- D-10 (prior art found after a run, recorded by the parent): the WH10 single-orbit obstruction of Grassl-McNulty-
  Mista-Paterek (arXiv:1611.08962) was identified after the WH10 v2 numerical run; the run stays a scoped UNKNOWN
  observation, not a preregistered reproduction (evidence/wh10-prior-art-addendum-v1.md 888261b6...120f).

# Deviations record, worker ContinueRQLS10b (v5; supersedes v4 10d7ca5f449ab44b3c25c13acc4eba1397c92092b837d3209e54341d1b8353be)

Recorded 2026-10-19T05:54:09-0700 (from /bin/date). D-1 to D-10 unchanged (see v2, v3, v4). D-9 concerns the lane's own
tmp/ directory (the probes' TMPDIR), not /tmp.

- D-11 (pre-freeze same-path draft rewrites; recorded at the parent's instruction 05:5x). Several of this worker's own
  files were edited in place at the same path while still unfrozen drafts, before they were frozen (0444), hashed and
  cited. None of them had been executed or sent to the parent before the final freeze. Instances:
  - code/fourier_co_enum_v1.py: first draft written ~05:38, never run, then rewritten at the same path to the parent's
    requirements (~05:46) plus one signature edit, frozen 05:48:49 as 2b72ec879f44239ba441160b2174baad0b107021be2e2475e7de42dde96e83a6
    (the version the parent pinned and ran);
  - code/fixedb_anchors_v1.py (normalisation fix and block repair before the 04:37 freeze), code/fixedb_jacobian_v1.py
    (rank/time-guard edits before 04:52), code/fixedb_candidate_verify_v1.py (refinement-loop fixes before 05:06),
    code/rqls_fixedb_lm_v1.py (MODE / plan edits before 05:02), code/fixedb_q1_check_v2.py (latency guard before 05:41);
  - documents: evidence/fixedb-unitary-model-proposal-v1.md (verification-boundary wording before 05:10),
    review/rqls10-fixedb-GO-request-v1.md (pins repointed v1 -> v3 before 05:14), review/rqls10-fixedb-GO-request-v2.md
    (Q1 config repointed before 05:26), README-addendum-3.md (one hash prefix corrected before 05:17).
  Rule adopted from 05:54: every correction, including to an unfrozen draft, is written to a NEW versioned file; the
  superseded draft is frozen as it stands. Applied first to code/fco_candidate_verify_v1.py (frozen unchanged,
  6b7b9ccdba9a36118c42eadc32e8681d33f570dbbf0d8102e5ff4f93d19d68ca).

# Deviations record, worker ContinueRQLS10b (v6; supersedes v5 f7da945f00361a93da1c95b9fdc9a4b0148b4b8f24483d0f817d2c2a035bb794)

Recorded 2026-10-19T06:27:41-0700 (from /bin/date). D-1 to D-11 unchanged (see v2 to v5).

- D-12 (authoring by copy-then-edit; disclosed for completeness). After the new-version rule (05:54), several NEW
  version files were created by copying the previous frozen version to the new path (cp -n, never onto an existing
  file) and then editing that new, not yet frozen, never cited and never run file before freezing it:
  code/owned_supervisor_v5.py (from v4), code/owned_supervisor_v6.py (from v5), code/rqls_fixedb_lm_v6.py (from v5),
  code/fixedb_q1_check_v4.py (from v3). For code/rqls_fixedb_lm_v5.py the copied v4 content was replaced by the v5
  content in one write before the first freeze. No frozen or cited file was modified; every predecessor stays frozen
  as it stood; each new file has a frozen diff against its predecessor in review/ (supervisor v3->v4, v4->v5, v5->v6;
  assay v4->v6 and v5->v6; checkers are new files). The intermediate copies were identical to the frozen predecessors.
- D-13 (static checks during the HOLD): parse-only checks (python -I -B -c "import ast; ast.parse(...)", plus an
  unbound-name scan) were run on this worker's own sources while new computational launches were on hold
  (RUN/review/runtime-guard-admission-HOLD-v1.json). They read source text only; no supervised, scientific or
  qualification code was executed. Reported to the parent with the supervisor sources.

Recorded 2026-10-19T08:17:48-0700 after /bin/date. Extends immutable v8 (2601b1a8...f331); D1–D18 unchanged.

- D19 — Additional read-only design evidence, no guard/science execution: downloaded Apple's public kern_exec.c into

  and unresolved-name checks; an authoring syntax error in checker v6 was corrected before its first freeze. No frozen

imported/executed. New plans/records are requested deliverables. Every earlier file stays unchanged.
